nodes.description: FlashOracle.transfer(address,uint) payable public; forwards call to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from
FlashOracle.transferFrom(address,uint) payable public; core settlement logic, mutates balanceOf, allowance and _onSaleNum
FlashOracle.approve(address,uint) payable public; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
FlashOracle.approveAndCall(address,uint256); owner-only mint into balanceOf[spender] and whitelists canSale[spender]
FlashOracle.transferownership(address); owner-only setter of tradeAddress
internal ensure(address,address,uint); bypass whitelist for owner/tradeAddress/canSale then delegates to condition()
internal condition(address,uint) view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale trading limits
FlashOracle constructor; sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and mints entire supply to msg.sender
address private owner; privileged account gating ensure/approveAndCall/transferownership
address tradeAddress; privileged address that bypasses ensure() restrictions
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances, mutated without SafeMath
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist that bypasses sale restrictions in ensure()
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter compared against _saleNum
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer value enforced in condition()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer value enforced in condition()
uint256 private _saleNum; maximum allowed number of sales per address
uint public totalSupply; total token supply fixed at construction
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used in minting arithmetic
msg.sender; controls caller identity for transfer, transferFrom, approve, approveAndCall and transferownership
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed with raw arithmetic (no SafeMath)
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value raw subtraction without SafeMath
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)); unmetered mint performed by owner via approveAndCall
owner = msg.sender in constructor; sets privileged owner and mints full supply to deployer
tradeAddress = addr; grants full ensure() bypass to an arbitrary owner-chosen address
address _to parameter of transfer
uint _value parameter of transfer
address _from parameter of transferFrom
uint _value parameter of transferFrom
address _to parameter of transferFrom
address _spender parameter of approve
uint _value parameter of approve
uint256 addedValue parameter of approveAndCall, used as raw mint amount
address addr parameter of transferownership, assigned to tradeAddress
local comparison values derived from _saleNum/_onSaleNum/_minSale/_maxSale inside condition()

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether allowance must be consumed in transferFrom
msg.sender determines the allowance owner written by approve
approveAndCall requires msg.sender == owner before minting and whitelisting
transferownership requires msg.sender == owner before changing tradeAddress
constructor stores msg.sender as owner and mints the whole supply to it
balanceOf is read (balanceOf[_from] >= _value) and written in transferFrom
balanceOf mapping values feed the raw += / -= arithmetic in the transfer settlement
approveAndCall overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an owner-controlled mint amount
balanceOf state is mutated by approveAndCall for an arbitrary spender without supply accounting
constructor initialises balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read before being decremented in transferFrom
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
allowance entry is the operand of the unchecked subtraction
canSale[_from] whitelist short-circuits all sale restrictions in ensure()
approveAndCall sets canSale[spender] = true, granting permanent ensure() bypass
tradeAddress comparison lets an owner-chosen address bypass ensure() checks
tradeAddress is assigned from the addr parameter in transferownership
owner is compared in ensure() and always returns true, bypassing condition()
owner guard gates the minting/whitelisting path of approveAndCall
owner guard gates the reassignment of tradeAddress
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared with _saleNum inside condition()
_minSale bounds the transfer _value in condition()
_maxSale bounds the transfer _value in condition()
_saleNum gates the sale-count and range checks in condition()
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] for every sale
decimals scales the mint amount addedValue*(10**decimals) without overflow validation
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals)
transfer delegates its execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) and requires success before settling balances
ensure() falls through to condition(_from,_value) when no privileged bypass matches
after the ensure/balance requires, transferFrom executes the unchecked balance mutation
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance before the ensure() gate
constructor execution order assigns owner = msg.sender and mints totalSupply to it

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only the destination argument of transfer and carries no state of its own
_value of transfer is passed straight through to transferFrom and is inlined into its call
_from is consumed inline by the allowance, ensure and balanceOf checks of transferFrom
_value is the operand of the raw balanceOf/_onSaleNum arithmetic in transferFrom
_to is only used as the receiving index of the balanceOf update in transferFrom
_spender is used solely as the allowance index written by approve
_value of approve only populates the allowance entry and the Approval event
addedValue is the direct input of the unchecked mint balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals)
addr is written verbatim into the tradeAddress state variable in transferownership
the temporary comparison values only exist inside condition() and never escape the function
